pregame.headline: 2nd T20I Updates: Samson or Sooryavanshi? India face dilemma
pregame.articleBody: Sanju Samsons poor form has put Indias opening combination under scrutiny ahead of the second T20I against the West Indies in Ranchi today, with the team management weighing whether to persist with him or pair teen sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi with Abhishek Sharma.India lead the five-match series 1-0 after an eight-wicket thrashing in the opener. But Samsons scores of 9, 7, 2 and 11 in his last four innings make for uncomfortable reading, especially with Sooryavanshi waiting for an opportunity at the top.Samsons last four partnerships have yielded just 7, 12, 2 and 29 runs. Indias middle order, led by captain Shreyas Iyer, has bailed the team out, with Iyer smashing his maiden T20I century in the series opener in his 68th match in the format.The management has backed Samson despite his struggles, even accommodating him at No. 3 at the Asian Games to allow Sooryavanshi to open. But another failure could intensify the calls for a change.Sooryavanshis fearless strokeplay makes him an attractive option, though the 15-year-old is still finding his feet at the international level. He scored 14, 13 and 15 in Indias 0-3 T20I series defeat to England before making 18 and 35 at the Asian Games.The decision is a balancing act between backing an established player and giving a promising youngster more exposure. For Samson, the Ranchi game offers another chance to turn his form around.India weigh pace-bowling changesIndia could also reassess their pace attack after Mayank Yadav conceded 16 runs in the opening over of the first T20I and struggled to contain the West Indies. He did claim the key wicket of Sherfane Rutherford in the penultimate over, which could work in his favour.All-rounder Nitish Kumar Reddy is another option, although using him with the new ball did not work particularly well in the preceding ODI series.Indias spin attack looked more settled, with Kuldeep Yadav and Axar Patel taking two wickets each. Naman Dhir also impressed with 3/31, adding another option with his off-spin.West Indies need more runsThe West Indies must improve on their 171 all out in the opener if they are to level the series. Shai Hopes side have plenty of batting firepower in Shimron Hetmyer, Rovman Powell, Roston Chase and Romario Shepherd, but they need to convert that potential into a bigger total.Against an India attack without Jasprit Bumrah, the visitors will look to make the most of their batting depth. A total above 220 could give them a stronger chance of challenging Indias powerful line-up.Conditions could also influence the contest. Dew was visible along the sidelines during Indias practice session, raising the prospect of a slippery ball and difficult bowling conditions in the evening. The toss could prove crucial, with the pitch expected to favour batters.India, having chased down 172 in under 15 overs in the opener, will be keen to maintain their momentum and move 2-0 ahead in the series.

report.headline: 2nd T20I Updates: Rutherford's fifty sparks WI fightback
report.articleBody: Naman Dhir comes into the attack and Sherfane Rutherford welcomes him with a massive six. Dhir manages to pull things back with a couple of dot balls before Rutherford pushes one towards cover-point and sets off for a single. Shreyas Iyer fires in a quick throw, but it is slightly off target and Rutherford makes it safely. Two more dots close out the over.Seven runs come off it. West Indies are 129/3 after 11 overs.Axar Patel returns, but Rutherford is in devastating form. He launches another huge six to bring up a brilliant fifty, with his teammates applauding the effort. A swing and a miss follows, and a wide adds to Indias troubles. Rutherford then smashes back-to-back boundaries, including another maximum, before the batters collect a couple of singles.Twenty-three runs come off the over. West Indies race to 152/3 after 12 overs, needing 98 from 48 balls.Naman Dhir continues, and Hope starts cautiously before launching a six. He then works one to deep mid-wicket for a single. Play is briefly interrupted as the ball is changed because it is not lighting up properly.Hope takes another single after the resumption, but Rutherford is furious when a delivery he feels should be called wide is not given. The next one is called wide, and Rutherford responds by smashing a boundary before finishing the over with a six.Eighteen runs come off it. West Indies surge to 170/3 after 13 overs, needing 80 runs from 42 balls.

report.headline: 2nd T20I Updates: Kuldeep removes dangerous Rutherford
report.articleBody: Arshdeep Singh returns with a yorker, and Shai Hope can only push it down to long-on for a single. Sherfane Rutherford follows suit before Hope rotates the strike again. Rutherford digs one back towards the bowler, then finds the boundary on the off side before taking another single to close the over.Eight runs come off it. West Indies are 178/3 after 14 overs, needing 72 from 36 balls. The chase is very much alive.Kuldeep Yadav then delivers a crucial breakthrough! Rutherford tries to reach out to a wide delivery and open the face of his bat, but Sanju Samson pulls off a superb catch behind the stumps. Rutherford walks back visibly frustrated after a stunning 84 off just 37 balls.Romario Shepherd is the new batter and gets off the mark with a single. Hope keeps West Indies in the hunt with another boundary, then finds the gap again, forcing Arshdeep into a long chase to keep the ball inside the rope.Nine runs and a wicket come off the over. West Indies move to 187/4, with Hope still leading the chase.

report.headline: 2nd T20I Updates: Hope, Shepherd silence Ranchi with power-hitting
report.articleBody: Axar Patel returns, but Shai Hope and Romario Shepherd continue to keep the West Indies chase on track. Shepherd picks up a single before Hope finds the boundary. Hope then rotates the strike, and after a mistimed shot, Shepherd finishes the over in style with a huge six.Twelve runs come off it. West Indies are 199/4 after 16 overs, needing 51 from 24 balls.Kuldeep Yadav continues, but Hope immediately takes him on, launching a massive six as West Indies cross the 200-run mark. The power-hitting doesnt stop there -- Hope clears the ropes again before taking a single.Shepherd then flexes his muscles and sends another delivery sailing into the stands. A wide adds to Indias worries, and after a rare dot ball, Hope finds the boundary to finish a punishing over.Twenty-four runs come off it! West Indies surge to 223/4 after 17 overs, needing just 27 from 18 balls. The crowd in Ranchi has gone unusually quiet as the visitors close in on a stunning win.

report.headline: 2nd T20I Updates: WI need 10 runs to pull off record chase
report.articleBody: Arshdeep Singh returns to bowl out his spell, with West Indies needing 27 from 18 balls. Shai Hope takes a single off a low full toss, and Romario Shepherd follows suit. Hope rotates the strike again before Shepherd takes charge.A full toss disappears over the ropes for six, and Shepherd follows it up with back-to-back boundaries! The West Indies all-rounder is making the finish look easy as India struggle to contain the onslaught.Seventeen runs come off the over. West Indies race to 240/4 after 18 overs, needing just 10 runs from 12 balls to pull off a stunning chase.

report.headline: 2nd T20I Updates: Hope's ton powers West Indies to record chase
report.articleBody: West Indies have stunned India with a record chase, hunting down 250 in just 18.3 overs to win with nine balls to spare and level the series 1-1! Captain Shai Hope seals the victory with a six over wide long-on, completing a breathtaking century off just 45 balls.Hope pumps his fists in delight as West Indies register their highest successful T20I chase, the second-highest in the formats history. His ton is also the second-fastest by a West Indies batter in T20Is.From 5/2 to a stunning victory, West Indies produce a sensational batting display, with Hope leading the charge in emphatic style.

report.headline: 2nd T20I Updates: India post record total against WI
report.articleBody: India 249-5 (20 Ovs) vs WI | SCORECARDWith only four fielders allowed outside the circle because of West Indies slow over-rate, India look to make the most of the gaps in the field.Shamar Springer bowls the final over, and Tilak Varma gets straight to work, launching back-to-back sixes to bring up a hat-trick of maximums! He moves to 43 off just 17 balls, while Shreyas Iyer is on 40 off 17.Tilak then takes a single, but Springer strikes back. Iyer skies one high into the air and Shimron Hetmyer takes a simple catch at deep mid-wicket. The extra bounce does the trick as Iyer departs for a blistering 40 off 18 balls.Naman Dhir walks in and finishes the innings in style, smashing a boundary off the final ball.Twenty-three runs and a wicket come off the last over as India post 249/5 -- their highest-ever T20I total against the West Indies. The visitors face a daunting target of 250!
